label: Machine
description: Blueprint-worthy machines across every family — state-neutral subjects written for technical-sheet and poster treatments.

items.name: longtail-hypercar
items.text: a long-tail hypercar, teardrop glasshouse flowing into full-length venturi tunnels, the rear wing standing on slender swan-neck pylons

items.name: group-b-special
items.text: a boxy Group B rally homologation special, riveted arch extensions, roof vent and quad driving lamps in a mesh-guarded row

items.name: 50s-gp-single-seater
items.text: a cigar-bodied 1950s grand prix single-seater, panel-beaten aluminium skin, wire wheels and a wood-rimmed steering wheel

items.name: land-speed-streamliner
items.text: a land-speed streamliner motorcycle, its rider enclosed under a hand-formed alloy fairing drawn out to a torpedo taper

items.name: endurance-superbike
items.text: a factory endurance superbike, quick-release fairings, wire-locked fasteners and stacked projector lights above the ram-air intake

items.name: delta-interceptor
items.text: a dartlike delta-wing interceptor, area-ruled fuselage and afterburner petals in raw heat-stained titanium

items.name: flying-boat
items.text: a four-engine flying boat, two-step planing hull, outboard wing floats and a forest of opened cowling flaps

items.name: coaxial-heavy-lift
items.text: a coaxial-rotor heavy-lift helicopter, twin stacked rotor heads above a fully glazed crane-operator nose

items.name: ekranoplan
items.text: a colossal ekranoplan ground-effect ship, stub wings and eight intake nacelles bunched at the nose, a tail the size of an airliner's

items.name: research-submersible
items.text: a deep-sea research submersible, syntactic-foam flanks, folded manipulator arms and a single thick acrylic view dome

items.name: j-class-yacht
items.text: a J-class racing yacht, towering Bermuda rig over a navy hull drawn to a knife-edge entry, deck hardware in polished bronze

items.name: express-steam-locomotive
items.text: an express steam locomotive, driving wheels taller than a man, connecting rods and valve gear laid out in polished steel

items.name: maglev-trainset
items.text: a bullet-nosed maglev trainset, flush glazing and levitation skirts riding a raised concrete guideway

items.name: crewed-lunar-rover
items.text: a skeletal crewed lunar rover, woven-mesh wheels, gold foil insulation and exposed chassis trusses under twin seats
